name: Google Analytics: Weekly Report
description: Generates Google Analytics data reports using AI and sends them via email and Telegram.

params.subject: Weekly Report: Google Analytics: Last 7 days

inputs.prompt:
Convert the following text from HTML to normal text:

{{last.text}}

Please format the table so that each metric is a separate paragraph!

Example:

Total views: xx.xxx
Total views previous year: xx,xxx
Difference: x.xx %

Total users: xx,xxx
Total users previous year: xx,xxx
Difference: -x.xx %

source.path: AI_Research_RAG_and_Data_Analysis/Create a Google Analytics Data Report with AI and sent it to E-Mail and Telegram.json

setup: Setup value gaPropertyId: Google Analytics 4 property id (for example properties/123456789). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value recipientEmail: Recipient email address (for example you@example.com). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value telegramChatId: Telegram chat id (for example 123456789). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate google-analytics-weekly-report.

hints: "Processing for email" used agent tools in the original: Calculator (toolCalculator). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect google-analytics: `cdecli credential create -n "google-analytics" -p google-analytics --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
Welcome to my Google Analytics Weekly Report Workflow!

This workflow has the following sequence:

1. time trigger (e.g. every Monday at 7 a.m.)
2. retrieval of Google Analytics data from the last 7 days
3. assignment and summary of the data
4. retrieval of Google Analytics data from the last 7 days of the previous year
5. allocation and summary of the data
6. preparation in tabular form and brief analysis by AI.
7. sending the report as an email
8. preparation in short form by AI for Telegram (optional)
9. sending as Telegram message.

The following accesses are required for the workflow:
- Google Analytics (via Google Analytics API): https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/credentials/google/
- AI API access (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or Ollama)
- SMTP access data (for sending the mail)
- Telegram access data (optional for sending as Telegram message): https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/credentials/telegram/

You can contact me via LinkedIn, if you have any questions: https://www.linkedin.com/in/friedemann-schuetz
